gen-amatic-sc-gf-stack-sans-headline: Quirky lettering leads here, thin and loose like a doodle. Stack Sans Headline holds the lower half with crisp, wide gaps, so Amatic SC gets to play while the body does the steady work.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch reads open and rod-straight, with big-bodied lowercase you can see right into. Amatic SC adds the hand-drawn wobble, while the body keeps every line plainly measured.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-stack-sans-text: Stack Sans Text reads like a marker line, modern and unfussy, with big-bodied lowercase and curve endings left well apart. Amatic SC sits above it like scribbled margin notes.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-sulphur-point: Amatic SC scrawls its way across the top, rustic and a bit cheeky, with terminals stopping far from the stem. And Sulphur Point brings bulky lowercase and a marker-like line, so give it a little more size.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-suwannaphum: Thin, squeezed-toothpaste strokes give Amatic SC its pencil-line look. Suwannaphum answers with tall, squared-off lowercase and a wide-open c, so the quirky scribble and the dignified body keep each other honest.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-tiktok-sans: Amatic SC draws wirelike strokes, all one hairline thickness. TikTok Sans carries more weight below, its tall lowercase and open c giving the rustic heading a modern, solid footing to lean on.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-ubuntu-sans: Contemporary and a little rounded, Ubuntu Sans has washer-big lowercase eyes and tubular strokes like bent copper pipe. And Amatic SC drifts above it, all pen-lifted wobble, giving the page a rustic hand.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-vend-sans: Ruler-straight lines and wide, unclosed curves make Vend Sans feel crisp, with an x-height that fills the line. Give that body a touch more size.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-yaldevi: Amatic SC writes in a casual, monoline hand, with terminals stopping well away from the stem. Yaldevi takes over below with outsized lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right, a clean counterweight.
gen-archivo-black-gf-bree-serif: Archivo Black stamps the top of the page with a tall x-height and generous space around each letter. But Bree Serif softens the tone below, its outsized lowercase giving a literary, refined voice.
